meta.description: Oronasal air-pressure recordings of Pakistani Panjabi. Nasalance is the share of nasal air pressure in the total of oral and nasal air pressure. Experiment 1 compares the vowels of monosyllables with a contrastive nasal vowel (CṼṼ) and with a vowel before a nasal consonant (CVVN); Experiment 2 compares the glide and the vowel before it in words ending in a vowel, a glide and a contrastive nasal vowel ([ṼG̃Ṽ=CV]), in an oral vowel ([VGV]), or in a vowel and a nasal consonant ([VGṼN]). Each table is a linear mixed-effects model with the condition dummy coded, so that an estimate is a difference from the intercept.
